about.what: reporting numbers printed next to far locality (amendment of 2026-11-12 06:16 UTC, decisions 4 and 5), per log
about.a: near_released_*: valid heldout_disjoint probes that ask the question of an edit of the log, percent on which an edit is released; behaviour = per-row files (mean over the behavioural draws), gate level = mean over the 20 calibration draws
about.b: false_firing_20_draws: rate on heldout_disjoint per calibration draw against the bound of the two-block rule (5 / 101); where_logonly has no gate-level read-out
about.c: capped_edits_20_draws: edits at their guard cap (for them the bound is void)
about.d: self_separation_margin: smallest margin and number of edits with a non-positive margin
about.e: rel_kept_gained_lost: Rel exact against the deployed log; kept = target under both, gained = only under the method, lost = only under the deployed log; percent of all edits, of the first 100 edits and of the later edits (stream position >= 500)
